Messages.Author: kuquami
Messages.Body:
A few questions concerning the new cards :

-Can Anesthetic Touch be played when Immortal Grapple is in effect ?

-Which allies/retainers can benefit from inferior Infection ? (that is
: which allies are ghouls ?)

-Same question for True Faith : Who can learn True Faith for a cost of
1 pool ? (which allies are non-infernal mortal allies ?)

-And the most important question : what is the music represented on
Rayzeel's Song's picture ? :) Same question for the Daughters of
Cacophony's background...

Pierre

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
kuquami wrote:
>
> A few questions concerning the new cards :
>
> -Can Anesthetic Touch be played when Immortal Grapple is in effect ?

You can't "Strike: dodge" with it (aus), no.
You can "strike: make a hand strike" with it (obe), sure.

> -Which allies/retainers can benefit from inferior Infection ? (that is
> : which allies are ghouls ?)

The ones that are printed as "Ghoul" or identified as "ghoul"
previously. See online card texts, or see the archived article
on Lasombra's site: http://www.thelasombra.com/lists/type.txt

> -Same question for True Faith : Who can learn True Faith for a cost of
> 1 pool ? (which allies are non-infernal mortal allies ?)

See the same list. All allies are non-infernal unless the card text
states otherwise.

> -And the most important question : what is the music represented on
> Rayzeel's Song's picture ? :) Same question for the Daughters of
> Cacophony's background...

...
